notes_for_editor: Build date conflict: 1938 CCC creosoted wood tower (Forest Lookouts, quoting a 1938 state report) versus 1949 Aermotor (WCTI Instagram reel, undated in our copy). The 120-foot height comes only from the 1938 entry and may not match the current structure. Standing status rests only on the October 2009 marker photo; the undated reel does not confirm current condition. The Forest Lookouts line says Hofmann State Forest; the marker calls Hofmann a research forest of 80,000 acres acquired for NC State in 1934. A Facebook video by a drone pilot repeats the 1949 date; it appeared only in search results and is not cited. Staffing, fires and public access are unknown. Confirm with the NC Division of Forest Resources before anyone visits.
